properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 8 at 1:48PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 148 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of showers and
isolated thunderstorms extending from 7 miles southeast of Boyero to
20 miles southwest of Forder, or extending from 29 miles south of
Flagler to 54 miles south of Limon, moving south at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Karval, Wild Horse Point, Forder and Boyero.
